bio.text: Brenda Sanders is the Green Party candidate for Michigan's 12th Congressional District in 2026, nominated at the party convention on July 18.
She was a judge of the Michigan 36th District Court and earlier practiced law in Detroit for 24 years, and she also served as house counsel for that court.
She received an undergraduate degree from the University of Michigan in 1980 and a J.D. from the University of Detroit Mercy Law School in 1983.
